svg.text: (a) Training: predict the state 5 env steps ahead
g history + action attend to the state tokens
the action also modulates each block (AdaLN)
state tokens attend to gt and ĝt+5
patch detail is written back from g
2-step rollout: step 2 starts from the step-1 prediction
Auxiliary predictor (action as one input token)
trains the encoder; the main predictor sends it 0.3 of its gradient
